$description: SisyphusFit design tokens (SPEC §10 rule 9). One source: tools/tokens.py checks it, writes SPEC §10's token tables from it and generates CSS from it (the Compose theme follows at the foundation step). Two layers: raw values (grey ramp, alpha black) and roles that screens use; screens never use a raw value. Greyscale until the palette is discussed (§10 rule 7): when colour comes, only the roles' references change. Sizes are dp, text sizes and line heights sp (0.49); density values are balanced / compact (0.34).

grey.$description: Named by CIE L* (rounded down). Every value is used by the decided screens (0.53, 0.54).

black.$description: Black at an alpha, for shadows and the scrim.

card.$description: comparison card, facts, light pebbles (steppers, the rest round's control), the tab bar

worn.$description: module cards, week sections, the resume card and rows: cut left, worn right (0.53)

worn-light.$description: the soft light toward their worn right side

sunk.$description: the bottom zone behind the main bar; secondary pills

dark.$description: every dark fill of the interface: main bar, tab bar line and underline, selected states (0.53)

dark-light.$description: the faint light inside the main bar's dip

primary.$description: text, icons, the current set's pebble outline

secondary.$description: secondary text, the evidence-note chip, tags

edge.$description: outlines (flat rows), the 1.5 dp underline of a number you tap to type, the sheet's grab handle, switches

carved-dark.$description: a carved line's cut: column heads, the chip's lines (3 dp, dark over light)

carved-light.$description: a carved line's lit edge; the 0.7 dp light under object icons

spindle.$description: History's carved date divider (owner 2026-10-28: the edge grey, not a grey of its own)

ground.$description: the 2 dp ground under a pill

step.$description: the 1 dp shadow under light pebbles

ring-track.$description: the white ring's track before it fills: the near leg's grey (0.46)

ring.$description: the ring and the time are the only white in the round (0.44)

gap.$description: between items in a list; compact keeps 8 as drawn and judged (the base compact scale had 4)

foot.$description: around the main bar in the bottom zone

note-head.$description: an evidence note's sheet: under its eyebrow, before the claim (owner, 2026-10-28 walk)

row.$description: minimum height of a row (0.49: text may make it taller)

card.$description: minimum height of a module card

button.$description: minimum height of the main bar and buttons

stepper.$description: the − / + pebbles beside a set value

float.$description: height of the floating running control as a pill (0.35)

float-round.$description: the floating running control as a round (0.35: recordings, the interval timer)

rest-control.$description: the rest round's touch target (0.45); the boulder is 80 at font size 1.0 and grows with the time (0.51)

tab-bar.$description: the tab bar at font size 1.0; it grows with its labels (0.53)

worn.$description: cut on the left, worn on the right (0.53)

full.$description: round ends: the grab handle, close and note chips

pebble-a.$description: light pebbles: the reps steppers, the rest round's control, the current set's outline

pebble-b.$description: light pebbles: the weight and partials steppers

selected.$description: a selected box, segment or chip

line.$description: the tab bar's line, the tap-to-type underline, the current set's pebble outline

carved.$description: a carved line, dark over light (0.53)

underline.$description: the current tab's underline on the valley floor (0.53)

ring.$description: the rest round's white ring and its track

ground.$description: a pill standing on the ground

valley.$description: the tab valley sliding to the new tab (0.53)

step.$description: one push step of the figure (0.44)

stone-turn.$description: about one turn of the stone (0.44)

reduced.$value: nothing turns or slides; the figure holds still; the ring and the time move once a second; the valley jumps (0.44, 0.53)

type.$description: §10 rule 8: size and line height balanced / compact in sp; carve set by the token (0 up to 16, 100 above); Sisifo (0.40).

comparison.$description: in the comparison card the roles keep their weight and carve at these sizes, the same at both densities (0.47, 0.52)

chip.$description: the evidence-note chip, on every screen it appears (0.47, 0.52)

note-claim.$description: an evidence note's claim: the row title's size on looser lines (owner, 2026-10-28 walk: 28 at balanced; compact keeps 24, already that proportion at 17 sp)
